svg.text: A TRI job with points (10, 2), (3, 6) and (14, 9): the pixels it writes
A pixel is written when its top
left corner is on or right of the
left edge and left of the right
edge, in the rows from the top
point's y up to, not including,
The bottom row and the right-hand edge are left for neighbouring triangles,
so triangles that share an edge write each pixel along it exactly once.
